name: tc-control-room
goal: The Crew, Phase 1 (2026-10-23): the pure-logic pieces of the egui control room. mdlite.rs reads the Markdown that the Night and Desk panes show (night reports, crew reports, review items); diffview.rs labels and numbers the lines of a commit request's unified diff. The PA writes the window, the file reading and the Desk's Python bridge.

tasks.instructions: Not CommonMark: follow the contract's rules in their stated order. inline works on a Vec<char> with an index and a text buffer that is pushed as Text only before another span and at the end. parse handles one line at a time with one open block (Paragraph, Bullet, Numbered or Quote) and a close step. Walk every row of both worked-example tables through your code before replying. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.

classify is a small state machine (OUTSIDE, HEADER, BODY with old_no, new_no, old_left, new_left): the first matching row of rule C's table decides each line, and table B decides lines inside a hunk. Use saturating_add / saturating_sub for every count. Walk the worked example and the files table through your code. Write the module once, in one reply; do not restate the contract.
